descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Experience Cricket Like Never Before – In Virtual Reality!

Step onto the pitch, hear the crowd roar, and enjoy an immersive VR cricket experience built for true fans. Whether you're setting a huge total or chasing a challenging target, every shot feels authentic with realistic batting physics and immersive controller haptics.

🏏 Features

Realistic VR batting with precise physics and satisfying haptic feedback.
Dynamic AI bowlers featuring right- and left-arm pace, yorkers, bouncers, swing, and spin deliveries.
Intelligent fielders with realistic catches, including dramatic caught-and-bowled dismissals.
Bat First Mode: Build a winning score and watch the AI chase your target.
Chase Mode: Hunt down dynamic targets while managing the required run rate.
Custom Matches: Choose from 5 to 50 overs and adjust difficulty from Beginner to International.
Live scoreboard displaying runs, wickets, overs, CRR, RRR, boundaries, and batting milestones.
Spectacular victory celebrations with fireworks, stadium light shows, and team-themed posters.

Master your timing, read every delivery, and take on the world's fastest bowlers in an authentic VR cricket experience.

Download now, wear your VR headset, and swing for SIX!
